# Support

## How to get help

| Need | Where |
|------|--------|
| Bug report | Open an issue on the **repository that owns the code** using the bug template |
| Feature idea | Open an issue using the feature request template on that same repository |
| Usage questions | Prefer issues on the relevant repo so answers stay with the tool |
| Security concern | See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — do not file a public issue |

## Software

Public and private tools in this org (default branch **`worx`**):

| Repository | Role |
|------------|------|
| [symworx](https://github.com/symworx/symworx) | Analysis stack (`symview`, crates, Python bindings) |
| [symkit](https://github.com/symworx/symkit) | Agent harness installer |
| [symcourse](https://github.com/symworx/symcourse) | Course repository scaffolder (private) |
| [symelib](https://github.com/symworx/symelib) | Local paper library (`elib`) |
| [symsight](https://github.com/symworx/symsight) | Article / social insight generator |
| [symjump](https://github.com/symworx/symjump) | Terminal jump list (`sjmp`) |

The analysis monorepo is in beta. Use that repo for biosignal / stats / TUI questions; do not file those on sibling tools.

## Before asking

1. Read that repository’s `README.md` (and crate docs under `crates/` for the monorepo).
2. Search closed and open issues for similar questions.
3. Include versions, OS, and minimal reproduction steps when something fails.

## Response expectations

This is open source software maintained as time allows. There is no guaranteed
SLA. Clear, minimal reproductions get the best results.
